title: Snow Bros.: Nick and Tom
shortDescription: Snow Bros.: Nick and Tom helps define a Game Boy family platformer path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Builds a traceable platformer option into the Game Boy family discovery path.
Links the catalog entry to a source record without presenting a rating.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Classified for the Game Boy family platformer discovery path using a source-linked Wikidata item; this remains a deterministic catalog-method entry rather than a provider verdict.
